cases.title: CRISPR-Cas9 Targeting Double-Strand Breaks and Non-Homologous End Joining
cases.brief: With guide RNA pairing with target DNA, Cas9 cutting, and NHEJ or HDR as the narrative backbone, featuring a white background, labeled lines, and gene sequence style symbols, suitable for Nature Methods-style captions or review illustrations.
cases.prompt_content:
A scientific schematic illustration in the style of a Cell / Nature Reviews Molecular Cell Biology figure panel (flat vector, not photo).

CORE CONCEPT
The figure illustrates: sequence-specific double-strand break by Streptococcus pyogenes Cas9 guided by a single guide RNA, followed by repair outcomes—error-prone non-homologous end joining (NHEJ) versus templated homology-directed repair (HDR) when a donor is present.

CENTRAL SUBJECT
The visual centerpiece is: a horizontal double-stranded DNA duplex (3′–5′ on top, 5′–3′ bottom) in deep blue; a single guide RNA (red-orange) hybridized to the target protospacer, with a short PAM (NGG) region highlighted; Cas9 (large gray/lavender ovoid) docked to the RNP–DNA ternary complex with a wedge at the HNH and RuvC nuclease sites.

SUPPORTING ELEMENTS
(1) A magnified insert (panel b) showing phosphodiester cleavage at positions −3 and +3 relative to the PAM, with small scissor marks.
(2) A dashed branch: left path labeled “NHEJ: indels, frameshift, knockout”; right path labeled “HDR: donor template, precise knock-in (low efficiency in G1)”.
(3) A tiny 20 nt spacer + tracr repeat cartoon above Cas9, connected by thin leader lines.

ANNOTATIONS
- Use leader lines (thin black, 0.8–1.0pt) to label: target DNA, protospacer, PAM, sgRNA, Cas9, HNH, RuvC, cut sites.
- Each label 11pt sans-serif (Helvetica / Inter / Arial), sentence case, no all-caps.
- 5–6 main labels; subparts (a)(b) in 10pt bold at top-left of each panel.

EQUATIONS
- Optional one-line: none required; or small grey note “ΔG_hybrid kcal/mol (qualitative)”.
- If showing knock-in, small italic: “P_HDR ∝ f(cell cycle, exogenous donor)” in margin.

COLOR PALETTE
- 3–4 muted academic colors:
  - deep blue #1E3A8A — target DNA
  - warm orange #C2410C — gRNA
  - medium gray #475569 — Cas9 and annotation lines
  - pale yellow #FEF9C3 — PAM and donor DNA outline
- White background; print-safe grayscale.

LAYOUT
- single panel ~60% width to central cleavage; right 40% split between two repair fates, aligned to grid.
- Aspect ratio: 4:3.
- 25% whitespace, invisible alignment grid, no decorative texture.

STYLE ENFORCEMENT
- Crisp vector lines; no drop shadow, no gradient, no 3D extrusion, no stock photo.
- All text typeset, never hand-lettered.
- NO cartoon characters, NO emoji, NO “science fair” clip art.
- Read like TikZ + Illustrator, peer-review quality.

CAPTION (optional, drawn below figure)
Figure. CRISPR-Cas9 (spCas9) RNP cleaves a genomic target 3′ of the PAM, enabling indel formation via NHEJ or precise editing via HDR when a homologous donor is supplied.（中文注：PAM 依赖性的靶向切割是 Cas9 编辑的核心约束。）

cases.title: Simplified Experimental Light Path for Two-Photon and Entangled Photon Pair Production
cases.brief: Pump Laser, Spontaneous Parametric Down-Conversion in Nonlinear BBO Crystal, Beam Splitting and Coincidence Counting, with Angle Annotations, suitable for PRL-style optics schematic emphasizing geometry and wavelength labeling.
cases.prompt_content:
A scientific schematic illustration in the style of Physical Review A / JOSA B experimental setup figure, orthographic side view, pure white #FFFFFF background.

CORE CONCEPT
The figure illustrates: a continuous-wave (or mode-locked) pump laser driving non-collinear type-II spontaneous parametric down-conversion in a birefringent BBO crystal, producing polarization-entangled photon pairs, followed by free-space collection, single-mode fiber coupling, and coincidence counting with tunable time delay in one arm to probe Hong–Ou–Mandel (HOM) or Bell-state tomography (conceptually indicated).

CENTRAL SUBJECT
The center is: a thin BBO crystal (rectangle, optic axis hatching) on an adjustable stage; pump beam shown as 405 nm (violet) collinear with crystal normal; o-ray (horizontal polarization, red) and e-ray (vertical, orange) idler/signal symbolically drawn as two cones intersecting a ring plane, simplified to two off-axis paths.

SUPPORTING ELEMENTS
(1) Far left: laser diode or Ti:sapphire block label “Pump λ=405 nm, P≈20 mW” with beam waist w_0 and polarization waveplate before crystal.
(2) After crystal: long-pass filter icon (dashed line box) to remove pump.
(3) A 50:50 non-polarizing beamsplitter cube (gray, diagonal interface) on the right, two output ports to APD or fiber collimators, labeled A and B.
(4) Small delay stage τ in one arm with double-arrow rail symbol for path-length tuning.

ANNOTATIONS
- Leader lines: crystal angle θ (e.g. ~29.2° for phase matching), f = 150 mm for collimation lenses on both arms.
- 6 total labels, 11pt sans; angles shown with small circular arc marks.
- (a) full layout, optional inset (b) ring intensity profile in transverse plane as false-color disk (very subtle, not neon).

EQUATIONS
- Phase-matching: Δk ≈ 0 along crystal axis, written as a small two-line block near crystal.
- Optional: N = (η_A η_B) R_coin formula near detectors (italic, small, not dominant).

COLOR PALETTE
- Deep blue #1E40AF (path A), vermillion #9A3412 (path B), violet #5B21B6 (pump), neutral gray for optics mounts.
- ≤4 colors, grayscale-safe edges.

LAYOUT
- 16:9 aspect ratio, generous margins 55–70 px equivalent; main beam path left to right, slight vertical separation of arms after BBO.
- No lens flare, no lens stock photos, only line-art optics symbols.

STYLE ENFORCEMENT
- Geometrically precise: parallel rays, 90° cube faces, symmetric BS.
- NO gradient fills on backgrounds; no decorative stars.
- English labels; optional 中文 caption line under the figure: “本图为概念示意，非等比例量测。”

CAPTION (optional, drawn below figure)
Figure. Simplified BBO down-conversion setup: pump photons are converted into orthogonally polarized entangled photon pairs, routed through a 50/50 BS for interference or coincidence; delay τ in one arm enables temporal overlap scans.

Title:
- 主标题「6 步在家希腊酸奶」用顶部大号手写体花字，放在手绘波浪线边框内.
- 副题小字：全脂牛奶 1L · 种菌 2 大勺 · 约 8–12 小时

Body:
- 6 information items, each a hand-drawn rounded card with:
  - 圆形编号章（1–6，线条略抖）
  - 小标题加粗手写感
  - 1–2 行说明（消毒容器、先加热到 85 °C 再降温到 40–45 °C、接种、密封发酵、过滤乳清、冷藏钝化）
  - 一步一个小涂鸦：奶锅、温度计、玻璃罐、纱布滤网、玻璃碗装成品
- Layout: 纵向蛇形，步与步之间用弯曲箭头连接，箭头旁可写「等待」

Doodle decorations (sprinkled, not symmetric):
- 小牛奶滴、优格勺、小星星; 在「勿频繁开盖」旁画一条可爱的禁止小手
- 一句中文强调圈出：发酵中途不要大幅晃动罐子

Style enforcement:
- ALL lines have visible hand-drawn wobble — never perfectly straight
- Color fills stop short of the outline (hand-painted gap)
- All text is hand-lettered — NO Helvetica, NO Arial, NO system UI fonts
- Slight imperfection is intentional; single coherent notebook page

Composition:
- Whitespace about 30–40% of canvas; title > 步骤名 > 正文 > 装饰

Language: 中文（手写体）；温标与单位保留阿拉伯数字和 °C。

Optional mascot: 一只简笔小奶牛头像在左下角，只占画面宽度的 6%，不要抢主流程。

cases.title: Contemporary Craft Exhibition of Mutual Learning Between East and West (Bilingual)
cases.brief: Chinese main title is the largest, English is a stylish subtitle, followed by exhibition dates and venue, with the main visual in the lower right as an abstract landscape geometric cut, vermilion red + ancient paper color, suitable for art museum displays.

cases.title: Shizuoka × Fuding 'One Leaf Crosses the Sea' Tea and Utensils Exhibition (Chinese-Japanese Comparison)
cases.brief: `main_en` typeset Japanese book title 'A Leaf Crossing the Sea', `main_zh` is the Chinese parallel title; `subtitle_en` contains the Japanese sub-line. Washi paper background + indigo and young grass, main visual features a tea bowl and a single leaf.

cases.title: Spring city marathon charity fundraiser (Japanese high energy).
cases.brief: Vermilion + cream + half-tone dots, with the main title taking up more than half the space, English at the bottom and small text for the organizers, suitable for subway lightboxes and full-column publications.

cases.title: Architectural Firm New Year Forum (Swiss Minimalist Typography)
cases.brief: Pure Black Text on White Background, Only One Line for Rhythm, Full White Space Greater Than 60%, Suitable for Job Site Barriers and Main Screen Standby.

cases.title: WeChat Two-Person Chat — Elon Musk × Mark Zuckerberg 'Octagon Cage Match' Dialogue
cases.brief: Recreate the 2023 Silicon Valley meme—Elon proposing a cage match with Zuck, and Zuck replying 'send location.' Here, it is adapted to a Chinese WeChat context: Elon Musk provocatively mixes Chinese and English, while Zuck responds seriously in a tech-savvy manner, featuring typical WeChat elements like text, voice notes, a Cybertruck selfie, location cards, and emoticons. This is a representative case of the 'celebrity friend's circle banter' template.

cases.title: Silicon Valley CEO WeChat Group Chat — 'Tech CEO Mutual Aid (8)' Midnight Rant
cases.brief: Upgrade 'Product Team Daily' into a high-end celebrity group chat — featuring Tim Cook, Sundar Pichai, Sam Altman, Jensen Huang, Mark Zuckerberg, Satya Nadella, and Jeff Bezos, with the user's perspective being Elon Musk. Content includes late-night Friday banter: not enough GPUs, returning Vision Pro, Gemini delayed again, @everyone reminders, message withdrawals, sending red envelopes, etc. This serves as a representative case for the template 'Highbrow Workplace Group Chat'.

cases.title: Claude Opus 4.7 AI Assistant Conversation — Helping Elon Musk Organize the 'Silicon Valley CEO Group' Weekly Report
cases.brief: Typical product screenshot of an AI assistant from the user's perspective, featuring Elon Musk, where he shares the group chat context from case 2 with Claude to help compile a 'Silicon Valley Drama Weekly.' Includes user questions, Claude's structured responses, and follow-up questions to rephrase into a Twitter/X post. A representative case for the 'AI Product Demo + Celebrity Usage Scenarios' template.
